properties.Observation: It is a naturally flowing stream. Water is being obtained informally using pipes.
properties.Description: Replanting bamboo species along the stream banks to prevent erosion

properties.Observation: A tank has been built at the site of the spring, but it is currently in a dilapidated condition. About 25 families draw water from it.
properties.Description:
Construction of a Water Stock Tank (2.0m x2.0m x 1.5m)

Site preparation & setting out

Plywood form work including making, fixing & removing for structure ‐05 uses

Cutting, Bending & Placing tor steel reinforcement bars

1:2:4 concrete with concrete mixer (volume batching)Plaster 12mm thick in 1:3 cement and sand finished smooth with gray cement floatingFabricating & fixing security weld mesh in open type buildings in GI weld mesh 50mm x 50mm SWG 10, welded on 40mm x 40mm x 5mm angle frame complete with application of two coats enamel paint over two coats of anticorrosive paint and complete. All as per detail drawing No.CPC/CS/11/04/2017/TYPE‐ST/07Tidying upContingencies (10%)

properties.Observation: An anicut has been constructed at the source to obtain water for the water project, and a water storage tank has been constructed below. About 40 families draw water from it.
properties.Description:
Replaster the Water Stock Tank (2.5m x2.5m x 2.0m)

Remove the existing plaster layer of the tank

Plaster 12mm thick in 1:3 cement and sand finished smooth with gray cement floating (Inside and the outside of the tank)
Tidying up

Tidying upConstruction of 1.5m high 1:3:6 (40mm) cement concrete Retaining Wall - To improve the anicutConstruction of a filter tank (1 m x 1 m x 1 m)Connect the anicut and the filter tank using pipe lineVegetative cover improving around the water source with Areca nut seedling in 1.5m x 1.5m grid, Kumbuk/ Mee/ Godapara/ Kaduru/ Aththikka/ Wal Del/ Kekuna/ randomly mixed seedlings and planting at 3.5m x 3.5 m grid interval - To conserve the soil around the spring locationContingencies (10%)
